parameters.help_en: The ID of the application that you want to scale out. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the elastic compute unit (ECU) that corresponds to the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance to be added to the instance group for scale-out. You can call the ListScaleOutEcu operation to query the ECU ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149371.html. Separate multiple ECU IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 指定ECU进行扩容。获取ecuid，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149371.html。多个ECU，用半角逗号（,）分开
parameters.name: ecu_info

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance group where the application you want to scale out is deployed. You can call the QueryApplicationStatus operation to query the group ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149394.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要扩容的应用实例分组。获取应用实例分组，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149394.html
parameters.name: deploy_group

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The ID of the change process. You can call the GetChangeOrderInfo operation to query the progress of this scale-out. For more information, see [GetChangeOrderInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62072.html）
ChangeOrderId.description_zh: 变更流程ID。可以调用GetChangeOrderInfo接口获取这次扩容具体执行进展，更多信息，请参见[GetChangeOrderInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62072.html）

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
